body:
UNKNOWN TENTACLE
CR 6

XP 2,400
N Large animal
Init +1, Senses tremorsense 60 ft., Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 4, flat-footed 13 (-4 Dex, -2 size, +9 natural)
hp 82 (11d8 +33)
Fort +10, Ref +7, Will +3
Immune cold, mind-affecting effects, poison
Space 5 ft., Reach 20 ft.

OFFENSE

Speed 0
Melee slam +13 (1d8+5/19-20 plus grab)

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 11, Con 16, Int 2, Wis 11, Cha 8
Base Atk +8; CMB +14 (+18 grapple), CMD 24 (28 grapple)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Retreat (Ex)

The monster has far greater hit points than displayed, but it will pul l back tentacles that are injured to its listed hit points. It fully retreats when all 3 tentacles are forced to flee.

Throw (Ex)

Creatures grabbed by a tentacle can be thrown by that same tentacle as a standard action. This is an opposed grapple check. If the tentacle wins, it causes 8d6 bludgeoning damage. The creature can throw creatures of size large or smaller up to 40 feet.
